mapper.sql: c.id,c.post_id AS postId,c.author_name AS authorName,c.author_avatar_url AS authorAvatar,c.content,c.created_at AS createdAt,r.id AS replyId,r.author_user_id AS replyUserId,r.author_name AS replyAuthorName,r.author_avatar_url AS replyAuthorAvatar,r.content AS replyContent,r.created_at AS replyCreatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE id=#{postId} AND deleted=0 AND status='PUBLISHED' AND published_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND parent_id IS NULL AND deleted=0

SELECT FROM comment c LEFT JOIN comment r ON r.parent_id=c.id AND r.deleted=0 WHERE c.post_id=#{postId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL AND c.deleted=0 ORDER BY c.created_at,c.id LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM comment c LEFT JOIN comment r ON r.parent_id=c.id AND r.deleted=0 WHERE c.id=#{id} AND c.parent_id IS NULL AND c.deleted=0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id,post_id,parent_id,author_user_id,author_name,author_avatar_url,content,created_at,updated_at,deleted,deleted_at,deleted_by FROM comment WHERE id=#{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id,post_id,parent_id,author_user_id,author_name,author_avatar_url,content,created_at,updated_at,deleted,deleted_at,deleted_by FROM comment WHERE parent_id=#{parentId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET author_user_id=#{ownerId},author_name=#{name},author_avatar_url=#{avatar},content=#{content},deleted=0,deleted_at=NULL,deleted_by=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=1
UPDATE comment SET deleted=1,deleted_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),deleted_by=#{ownerId} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE comment SET deleted=1,deleted_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),deleted_by=#{ownerId} WHERE parent_id=#{parentId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE post SET comment_count=GREATEST(comment_count-1,0) WHERE id=#{postId}
